name: thumbnail-strip
title: Thumbnail strip
description: A row or column of small previews that chooses the big picture: arrow-key selection, the active one ringed and scrolled into view, and fading edges.
docs: items are { id, src, alt, kind, duration }; value, defaultValue and onChange(id, item, index) choose the one shown in the large picture. The strip is one tab stop: the arrow keys move and choose, Home and End jump, and every preview is a button with aria-current. orientation is horizontal or vertical (give a vertical strip a height), size is sm, md or lg, and ratio is the shape of a preview. A video shows a play badge and its length. When there is more than fits it scrolls natively, and the fade at an edge grows with the scroll as more of the strip lies beyond it.
